7.1.3 VFB trace
The VFB trace is specified in the RTE. The meaning of VFB trace is an implicit (system
inherent) forwarding of SW-C communication data (which flows over the RTE) to the Dlt
module. Trace means in this case that no explicit call by the SW-C is made to forward
this data to Dlt. This section describes the interaction of the RTE with the Dlt module
to record a VFB trace and the internal control of the trace data.
